Problem
Consider a graph G = (V, E) consisting of n vertices. Assume there exists a constant α > 0
such that for every subset S ⊆V with cardinality |S| = n/2, the set of neighbors of S
satisfies the inequality:
|{w ∈V : ∃v ∈S, (v, w) ∈E}| ≥n
2 + αn.
Let k be an arbitrary positive integer, and consider a sequence of subsets W1, . . . , Wk ⊆V
where |Wi| ≥(1 −α)n for each 1 ≤i ≤k. Prove that it is possible to construct a path
(v1, . . . , vk) in G constrained such that vi ∈Wi for every index i in the range 1 ≤i ≤k.
